test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the correctly spelled sentence.

options.text: The scienctist discovered a new planet in the galaxy.
The scienctist discovered a new planet in the galexy.
The scientist discovered a new planet in the galaxy.
The scienetist discovered a new planet in the galaxy.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "The scientist discovered a new planet in the galaxy."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"scientist"** means a person who is trained in science and specializes in conducting research, experiments, and studies to understand natural phenomena. (वैज्ञानिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist worked tirelessly to develop a vaccine for the disease.
 
 
 
• **"Galaxy"** refers to a vast system of stars, planets, gas, and dust bound together by gravity. (आकाशगंगा)
 
 
• **Example:** The Milky Way is the galaxy that contains our solar system.
 
 
 
• Hence, the sentence "The scientist discovered a new planet in the galaxy" is correctly spelled and makes complete sense.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "The scienctist discovered a new planet in the galaxy."

 
 
• The word "scienctist" is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "scientist." (वैज्ञानिक)
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "The scienctist discovered a new planet in the galexy."
 
 
• The word "galexy" is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "galaxy." (आकाशगंगा)
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "The scienetist discovered a new planet in the galaxy."
 
 
• The word "scienetist" is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is "scientist." (वैज्ञानिक)
 
 

153:Tdb9,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
